reviews.text:
i’m genuinely shocked by the way this clinic handled such a heartbreaking situation. watching someone have to seek multiple opinions while their dog’s condition continued to worsen is upsetting enough, but the lack of compassion and accountability made the experience even worse.

the owner’s communication was incredibly disappointing. instead of listening to concerns, there was interrupting, dismissiveness, and seemingly more interest in defending himself than acknowledging why someone was upset in the first place. when someone is dealing with a seriously ill pet, basic empathy and the ability to listen should be the bare minimum.

what makes it even more concerning is seeing how criticism appears to be handled publicly. if your instinct when someone describes a negative experience is to argue with them rather than reflect on why they left feeling that way, that says plenty on its own.

people trust veterinary professionals with members of their family. they deserve compassion, clear communication, and accountability—especially when the situation is devastating. based on what i’ve seen from this experience, i would never feel comfortable trusting this clinic with an animal i love.

and before there’s a defensive response underneath this review: sometimes listening is more valuable than proving you have an answer for everything.
this place is terrible. the owner is rude, as you can even see the way he responds to others bad reviews. do yourself a favor and take your pet somewhere else that’s worth your time and money.

Worst experience you could have with them, especially with the owner. Unprofessional, rude and with no empathy with the people suffering. Can’t explain scans. Had to go to different vet to understand what was going on after paying them for the scans and exams.

Very rude and disrespectful, also haves a nasty disgusting attitude with females. Had someone I know wait weeks to tell her that there’s nothing she can do with her dog. Very unprofessional!. I don’t recommend this place at all .

Horrible how they treat the customer when asked about an issue! It’s incredible that they sent the report from all the test performed on the day of the visit, but never got a call to explain the results. I think they feel we’re all vets that can read and understand all the fancy medical terms. Well, ended up getting the opinion and results explained by 3 other vets, all explained the results and the options to the last detailed. Silver Bluff animal clinic, you’ve lost a client, and I’m sure few more after they get the same treatment.

When your dog is critically ill and you’re terrified you may lose them, the absolute last thing you should have to deal with is being belittled, dismissed, or made to feel like your concerns don’t matter. We tried to voice our concerns and ask questions about our dog’s scans, but instead of feeling heard, we felt talked down to and brushed aside. There was an unbelievable lack of compassion and empathy for both our dog and our family during an incredibly serious situation. When someone is facing the possibility of losing their dog, kindness, communication, patience, and basic human decency matter. Unfortunately, that was not the experience here. I would never want another family to experience this feeling during such a devastating situation.
Rude
Unprofessional behavior.

We take concerns about our patients and clients seriously. This review
appears to relate to the same matter addressed in our detailed response to
the original review. Out of respect for client and patient privacy, we will
not discuss an individual's medical care publicly or engage in repeated
online discussions regarding the same matter. We stand behind the care,
compassion, and communication provided by our team.

DO NOT GO HERE!!!!
The doctor or owner of this place is far from professional and if you don’t want to do things “their” way they will have a total meltdown. It all started because they wanted to check my dogs temp by putting a thermometer in his ass which I declined. When the male doctor came to my room he was extremely aggressive with his tone and attitude and saying we have a protocol and you need trust us and the steps we take. I told him no I’m not comfortable with it so let’s just move onto the exam. (This is to just check his allergies and to get him on medicine) At this point the room was tense and the assistant starts to grab my dog who clearly can feel the hostile energy and starts wiggling around and he goes see this is why we have a specific process your dog is clearly nervous and I told him yeah because this room is hostile, your raising your voice at me and and stranger is holding him of course he’s nervous that’s when he goes “you know what maybe we’re not for you”. So I told him your right and I should’ve known considering my friends dog died in your care. He’s says “a lot of dogs have died in my care, it happens”.

Idk about you but that was enough for me to hear. I’ll take my service elsewhere. Also heads up a standard exam will cost $130!!! Not worth it

Love Dr. Shana! So happy she chose Miami & Petsmart close to my home as her new clinic spot. Caring & professional staff, extremely reasonable prices for the quality pet of healthcare given.
Dr. Shana takes her time to explain services needed & shows a high level of care for your pet. I recently had a scare with my Poodle pup & Dr. Shana was swift in getting me in & finding solution to my pups problems.
5 STAR Vet in my book. Thank you Dr. Shana!

We always have such a wonderful experience here!

The staff is knowledgeable and always so kind and compassionate. You can tell that they absolutely love what they do.

They are also very transparent with pricing and always explain what they are doing (to both the humans and animals ❤️) so everyone is comfortable.

They are so loving towards the pets and treat them with so much respect. And they are also very nice to us humans too!

My personal opinion is that this is the best vet in Miami and I only trust my kitties with them.

100/10!!!
The worst. Don't take your beloved fur babies here. They don't take responsibility for their actions and unprofessional behavior.
So far so good. No complaints.

This clinic is horrible. I took my dog in because she was pooping and vomiting excessively, and they had told us that it was nothing, just an upset stomach, and they prescribed medication to take back home with us, and that she would be fine. Our first mistake was believing that was true. the next day comes and our dog got a lot worse she threw up once again and started whining due to the pain she was enduring. We take her back into the vet keeping her there for over four hours and getting charged a bill of $1000 and there was never any improvement. They even told us at one point that we could take her to an emergency room and literally two minutes After leaving the vet, our dog collapsed and stopped breathing So we took her back in and they tried to charge us for admission when we were there literally just two minutes ago, so imagine the bill from before and then they wanted to charge us for re-admission. RIDICULOUS. We kept her there for another few hours and they were never able to tell us What she actually had, and she only seemed to decline with her time in there the doctor Also does not know how to talk to his patient whatsoever he repeatedly just told us over and over again that if we left And attempted to take our dog to an emergency hospital, she would die. Of course we want the raw truth But there are ways to go about how to say such sensitive comments. The doctor was also super rude and dismissive, and he almost brushed off the worries and the doubts that we had. Our dog unfortunately, passed away on the ride to the emergency hospital. If you are having an emergency with your dog and they need immediate attention DONT bring them here. They were dismissive when we first went in and actually had the chance to avoid her death by telling us it was just an “upset stomach” and that she would be okay. Please do not bring your pets here.
UPDATE AFTER REPLY:
The only reason you guys didn’t charge us a readmission fee is because we confronted reception about it and made you guys drop it. The clinic was FULLY Intending to charge us  the readmission fee had we not spoken up about it. Regarding the oxygen tank that the owner gave us, it wasn’t  even halfway full. It was already about to die (on the red marking by the way) and didn’t last a 25 minute car ride. The owner also proceeded to tell us the oxygen tank was “on the house” as if he was doing us a favor for giving us an empty tank of oxygen. I’ve read through some of the bad reviews and your replies as well and it’s astonishing how you can’t take any accountability and you try to flip it and blame the patient’s owners. You guys are extremely unprofessional and my dog left this clinic worse than when she got admitted. Like you said eight hours spent on her yet no improvement. Absolutely ridiculous.
Horrible place

We would like to thank Dr. Sanchez, Dr. Caos, and Dr. Vega  and the staff at Silver Bluff for the care they provided to our beloved Tarzan.
Dr. Vega was extremely compassionate and caring at the end of his life. She was thorough in walking us through such a difficult decision. We are appreciative to all! Thank you for the care you have provided to all our pets for over 20 years!

We had to make the hardest decision of our lives and say goodbye to our beloved dog Tyson, and Silver Bluff Animal Clinic was incredibly compassionate through every step.
The staff was kind, patient, and respectful, giving us the time and space we needed to say goodbye. They treated Tyson with so much dignity and love, which meant everything to us in such a painful moment.
We will always be grateful for the warmth and care they showed our family. Thank you for making such a heartbreaking moment a little more peaceful.
Amazing team, from the front desk to the doctor & techs! They have such an attention to detail and explain things so clearly.

I have been visiting this clinic over the years and have found them to be very passionate and understanding of your pets needs. The veterinarians quickly diagnose and truly take the time to explain what issues your pet is facing. This isn’t like other vet offices that they quickly go through your pet’s assessment and there is little or no feedback. Thai staff does take the time to ensure you understand the steps needed to treat our companions.

Unfortunately my dog has skin issues and have tried oral meds to no avail. I stopped by yesterday to finally get her an injection to help her with the chronic issue. Not only did they get me a next day late appointment but I was seen within minutes by one of the nurses at the clinic. Not what I was expecting and was elated at how quickly I was attended and provided with the medication. The quick turn around helped rush back home and attend to a work related urgency.

Because of this visit alone I am a client for a long time coming. Thank you so very much for the incredible staff at Silver Bluff.

This is my honest experience. I really wanted to like this vet (they came highly recommended) but both times I called during an emergency, no one picked up. The first time, they called back 20 minutes later when I was already rushing to another clinic. The second time, I called again for an urgent issue and once more, no answer. Instead, I got a text message 2 minutes later asking me to explain why I was calling.

That’s not how you treat a worried dog mom in crisis. What made it worse is that when I shared my feedback, the clinic actually “respectfully disagreed” with my experience instead of simply acknowledging how it felt as a client who couldn’t reach anyone when she thought her dog might be dying.

If you just need a vet for vaccines or routine care, maybe this place is fine. But if you ever need real, timely, compassionate help, look elsewhere.

I would like for this person if possible to give us a call as this is a better way of helping us become better and understand why you are giving us a three star review. I understand that in this day and age someone feels empowered to write reviews but I believe it is more helpful to first reach out personally so that we can discuss the situation...

I have a last minute rescue dog emergency where she just need to be vaccinated so I can board her I go to the clinic at 7:30 on the dot they say they coildnt help me. Appt only. 5 girls doing nothing but being om their phones. These people don't really care about animals
I would not take my family anywhere else and you shouldn’t either.

Silver Bluff has been the go to for my daughter’s pets for years. The medical staff changes often, but the doctors are always great.
Lately the prices have gone up, but to be fair so have everything else in Miami.
Don’t let the jungle in the front stop you. The inside is very neat and the employees are always cleaning and disinfecting the place. I am not certain why the outside is so unkept.
My kids have been to many different vets, but seem to like this one the most.
Give it a try.

It’s hard to put into words just how exceptional Silver Bluff Animal Clinic is. They’ve been our trusted vet since the day we brought our dog home almost seven years ago and we truly consider them an extension of our family.

Over the years, they’ve helped us navigate everything from the routine to the worrisome: ear infections, strange symptoms, late-night questions, and more. No matter what it is, they always respond with thoughtfulness, compassion, and clear guidance, even when we’re sending them gross poop photos over email.

This morning, our dog had a seizure. It was terrifying. Without hesitation, we rushed to Silver Bluff because, honestly, there’s no one we trust more with one of the most precious parts of our lives. The team immediately jumped into action, cared for our pup with incredible expertise and tenderness, and just as importantly, helped keep us calm in the process. Their care for animals is only matched by the way they care for the humans who love them.

We’re endlessly grateful to every person on their team, specially Dr. Sanchez and Dr. Vega. If you’re looking for veterinary care that’s warm, compassionate, and deeply committed to your pet’s wellbeing, Silver Bluff is truly one of a kind.

After spending 2hours and a half in their office, for a skin allergy, we left with a prescription for an antibiotic that is 20times the amount our dog can handle. After dealing with him vomiting and having diarrhea we checked the medicine. Result is our dog has been prescribed a dose that is 20times what his weight requires. Professional?

Over the years, the care we received at Silver Bluff was … typical. Until one of our cats started eating less. From there, we were recommended a number of costly procedures and tests that ended up causing much stress and expediting our beloved cat’s decline and death.

I will never forgive the Silver Bluff team for not providing us with better options to choose from. And I will never forgive myself for putting my sweet kitty through such invasive testing and procedures during his last few days with us. Looking back, I wish I had sought out a more experienced and thoughtful vet sooner.

Thankfully, I was introduced to a new vet who understood a more compassionate approach to end of life care - as opposed to the recommendation for steroids from the Silver Bluff team. Under this care, we received incredible support during the final days, ensuring our kitty was comfortable and calm.

I share this with the hope that the team at Silver Bluff tries to do better, and that the humans who are responsible for these beautiful fur babes demand more from their vets.

This was my third visit.  The first visit was good.  The second visit was not.  I was told that my puppies that were a year and a half old needed to have non anesthetic dental cleaning.
Today they were nice enough to make room for my dog who’s been struggling for two months with mites. The Assistant came in to get the History and talk to us about everything. She was incredibly compassionate and kind. Then the vet walked in. I think her name was Vega. She was argumentative and condescending she was trying to tell me that my dog had fungus or bacteria which makes zero sense since both of my dogs have it and I was actually bit by the mites myself.
I guess it was obvious that I wasn’t happy so they sent the Office Manager in too try to frame me as a difficult person. And then I told her I didn’t feel comfortable with the vet, and why, and she told me I would still have to pay for the appointment. Obviously, all they care about is money because as a doctor myself, I would never charge someone who was not happy with my approach.
I left and went to another vet who confirmed that my dog had mites and the bill for the visit was half of what Silver Bluff charged me.

If your dog is having an Emergency situation. Don’t go there! ( Even if you took your pet there for years and trust the Dr)  They will waste your time, charge you $1000 for 3 hours and at 5pm when it’s time to clock out and not even the dr is there, they will tell you that there’s nothing they can do and you need to take your dog to the emergency vet. And that’s where my dog died.
Great place! Recommended. I have been taking my dog here for a year.

This is the only vet’s office where my dog felt truly at ease. Every visit, she remained calm and comfortable, which was a huge relief. Dr. Alex Caos and Ted Sanchez are absolutely fantastic, and the amazing staff who support them make all the difference. Their love, compassion, care, and patience meant the world to Anastasia and me. I am eternally grateful for everything they’ve done. Thank you!

I took my puppy there for the first time last week.  I was very impressed with Dr Vega and the staff.  Very gentle and caring with my nervous puppy but also through.  Took time to answer all my questions and followed up with me 2 days later.  Office has both inside and outdoor waiting areas and parking steps from the entrance.  It was a great experience and Spot and I will going here from now on.
Dr. Sanchez is great, thank you.

Silver Bluff is absolutely the best animal clinic in Miami (and we’ve been to a handful throughout)!  Dr. Ted is the most knowledgeable vet with all the conventional medicinal knowledge as well as all the functional and nutritive knowledge that you may need.  The other vets are equally great.  This is the clinic that has it all!

I brought my Frenchie, Pablo, here for the first time to get vaccinated and to treat an eye injury. The staff and Dr. Sanchez were wonderful and treated us with so much care and compassion. The office felt very homey & welcoming unlike any other vet office I’d ever been to. I highly recommend Silver Bluff Animal Clinic without hesitation.

Do not take your pets to this place if you care about them! The woman at the front desk has to be about the rudest person I've ever encountered working with the public.
I am sure the doctor is good, but the attendant jobviously just doesn't want to be there. That's the lease. I can say about that. It's a shame because Silver Bluff Animal Hospital used to be good.  My neighbor pretty much says the same thing..
I don't really don't even write reviews, unless I find something I really want to recommend. But I just had to write this one.
Jay Junco
Silver Bluff resident

Was looking for a place that wasn’t going to charge an arm and a leg. Needed a consultation on worries on my dog and a friend recommended this place. Got an apt pretty quickly & let me say I love this place. Friendly atmosphere, people were so welcoming. They went over everything before doing or charging you, so you’d know what to look for. Saw Dr. Sanchez and he was great, Sora also took care of my little baby and she was so nice! Definitely will be back
Best services! I loved! The staff are the best.

A very well decorated clinic, you still don't feel like you're in New Orleans when you enter. The staff is very unsympathetic to people who don't speak English. Everything is based on the computer and email. After spending a fortune on the physical exam and the labs, they don't call you, they send you the information by email and sometimes it's not complete. As in my case, I was the clinic to speak with the doctor and after a short waiting time the doctor was to see me very upset and bad manners

Today I called to bring in my cat who is sick and obviously needs care and an IV drip, and the person who answered told me that since I'm not a regular customer, she couldn't give me an IV drip for my cat and told me to call my vet and hung up on me. What a lack of respect! If I had a vet, I obviously wouldn't have called to listen to that lowlife who answered the phone.
Silver Bluff and Ted Sanchez is an awesome, caring and compassionate veterinarian. We wouldn’t have our two labs cared for by anyone else.
Knowledgeable and experienced vets. They treated my dog with kindness and respect while also not giving her a bunch of meds. I love their holistic approach and how cozy the office is!
Finally found the vet I will stay with for life. Love this place
Highly recommend. Just had my first visit here with my older pup and was so impressed by the demeanor of the staff and the space. Highly recommend.
Love love silver bluff.. ramen has had a few puppy incidents and they treat him so well! The entire team is very friendly, knowledgeable and helpful.🫶🏼🫶🏼 …

By far one of the best vets in Miami, the prices are pretty reasonable. I love how the staff is so friendly and clearly you can see that they all enjoy and love animals very much. They are professional, responsive to calls and emails and concerns. I love how they are extremely organized. I love this vet!
